# Juniper Cloud Q2 Call

## Cloud migration

Customers moved another eight percent of managed workloads from legacy hosting to the cloud platform.

## Security products

Demand for identity monitoring increased after the company added automated incident response.

## Customer churn

Monthly customer attrition on the cloud platform declined from one point eight percent to one point three percent.
